title: Avalon Bottom Load Water Cooler - Died after 2 weeks!
text: Avalon Bottom Load Water Cooler - Died after 2 weeks!. Made it through ONE FIVE GALLON WATER BOTTLE and then would not work!!  Tried customer service from the manufacturer.  They said the purchase from Amazon had to be handled by Amazon.  I was NOT IMPRESSED WITH THE  AVALON CUSTOMER SERVICE.  AMAZON was great, as usual.  They offered a replacement and since this only made it less that two weeks, it was decided that we did not want the same brand.  Amazon gave options and we settled on a credit and then purchased another brand (a older, trusted brand) of water dispenser.  We actually went with the top load thinking there would be less possibility of failure.  We are looking forward to the new water cooler and thank Amazon for their professional courtesy to their customers.

product_metadata.title: Avalon Bottom Loading Water Cooler Dispenser with BioGuard- 3 Temperature Settings- UL/Energy Star Approved- Filtered
features: Filtration Without Installation: This Water Cooler Comes With A Refillable 5 Gallon Bottle That You Can Refill From The Tap And Allow The Built-In Dual Filtration System To Filter The Water.

DUAL FILTRATION: Patented Dual filters are included with the water cooler. This consists of a Sediment filter (listed as model Avalon A5FILTER) and a Carbon Block filter (listed as model Avalon A4FILTER) which will last 6 months or 1500 gallons.
Three Temperatures: Three Temperature Settings Allow You To Customize Your Drinking Experience. This Dispenser Features A Crisp Cold, Cool, Or Piping Hot Output
Bottom Loading: Our Water Cooler Is Bottom Loading To Eliminate The Strain Of Lifting. Simply Fill The Included 5 Gallon Bottle From Your Tap And The Water Cooler Will Filter The Water.
CHILD SAFE: This product is UL Listed and features a child safety lock on the hot water spout so the entire family can use it worry free.
description: The Avalon 3 Temperature Bottom Loading Water Cooler With Filtration Is Made With An Innovative Stainless Steel Body. It Offers A Choice Of 3 Water Temperatures. The Easy-To-Use Push Button Spouts Make It So Much More Convenient To Use. Simply Press The Temperature Button Of Choice And Allow The Water To Flow From The Given Spout. The Machines Highly Efficient Compressor Makes The Cold Water Crisp And Ice Cold At Approximately 47° F Without The Need Of Adding Ice Cubes To Your Drink. The Hot Faucet Is Hot Enough To Cook One'S Tea Or Coffee Or Any Other Steaming Hot Beverage At Approximately 185° F. Due To The Extremely Hot Water, We'Ve Added A Child Safety Lock On The Hot Water Faucet. We Have Incorporated A Nightlight That Can Be Switched On From The Back Of The Unit. This Will Make Filling Up Your Cup At Night So Much More Simple And Easy. The Dispensing Area Is 12X3X10 Inches With 9 Inches Of Space Below The Spouts. This Will Accommodate Most Large Cups Or Bottles. There Is A Removable Drip Tray At The Bottom Of The Dispensing Area To Catch Any Drips Or Spills. This Water Cooler Is Bottom Loading With A 5 Gallon Refillable Bottle As Well As An Nsf Certified Activated Carbon Filter (Listed As Model Avalon A4Filter) And A Sediment Filter (Listed As Model Avalon A5Filter) In The Cabinet. The Water Is Pumped From The Bottle Through The Sediment And Carbon Block Filters And Into The Machine. There Is An Replace Filter Indicator That Will Alert You When To Replace The Filters And An Empty-Bottle Indicator That Will Will Alert You When The Bottle Needs To Be Refilled. The Water Cooler Is Ul Listed And Complies With All Standards Of Energy Star. The Unit Dimensions Are 41X12X13 Inches.

details.Included Components: 5 Gallon Bottle, Sediment Filter, Carbon Block Filter
